title: Clean Inventorys
description: A clean vanilla-style inventory texture pack that makes Minecraft’s GUI smoother, simpler, and easier to use.
body:
# Clean Inventorys
**Clean Inventorys** is a simple Minecraft texture pack that makes the inventory and GUI look smoother, cleaner, and easier to use. It keeps the vanilla Minecraft style while removing messy or distracting parts, making it perfect for SMP, PvP, survival, and grinding.
- This pack is made for players who want a fresh and clean inventory look without changing the game too much. It gives Minecraft a more polished feel while still staying close to the original vanilla design.

## Compatibility
* Tested on: 1.21.x - 1.20.x
* Other versions: not tested

## Requirements
* **No mods required**, this pack works on vanilla Minecraft.

## Credits
* Pack created by **[_Melted](https://modrinth.com/user/_Melted)**.
